title: Check Ethernet driver status
summary: Identify which kernel module drives your Ethernet card and verify if it is loaded.

steps.explain: List Ethernet controllers and their kernel drivers.
steps.expect: Output showing the Ethernet controller and 'Kernel driver in use: <module_name>'.

steps.explain: Check if the driver module was loaded by the kernel.

placeholders.name: MODULE_NAME
placeholders.description: The kernel driver name from the previous step (e.g., ixgbe, r8169).

steps.expect: Log lines indicating the driver initialized the device.
